title: Subpolynomial dimension reduction in Lp
summary: For every fixed $`1\lt p\lt \infty`$ and D > 1, every n -point subset of a real L p space embeds into $`\ell_p^d`$ with distortion at most D and subpolynomial dimension $`d=n^{o(1)}`$. The target has the same exponent p , and the embedding need not be linear.
family_title: Subpolynomial dimension reduction in L p

review.reason: Gives low-distortion embeddings of finite subsets of Lp spaces into low-dimensional lp spaces.
